                                              Consulting Services Agreement
         AGREEMENT No:           BCSA 2026-0101 – PHB – CEO REMUNERATION REVIEW
         BETWEEN:                BRIAN HART CONSULTING LIMITED (“BHC”)
                                 PO BOX 190, VISION CITY, NCD
         AND:                    PACIFIC HARBOUR BOARD (“PHB”)
                                 PO BOX 1234 PORT MORESBY, NCD

         AGREEMENT: In consideration of payment by Pacific Harbour Board of the fees indicated, BHC agrees to provide
         Pacific Harbour Board with services necessary to perform the Works identified in the Services Schedule. Unless
         expressly stated otherwise, times to perform works are estimates only. The parties acknowledge and agree that this Agreement
         shall be subject to the Terms and Conditions set out on the reverse of this page.
                                                           SERVICES SCHEDULE
         PROJECT
                                 PACIFIC HARBOUR BOARD CEO REMUNERATION REVIEW
         NAME:
         SCOPE OF WORKS          BHC will provide a Salary Benchmarking Report and Job Evaluation (“CEO Report”) for the PHB CEO.
                                 The tasks BHC will perform to deliver the CEO Report are:
                                 1.  Conduct a review of the CEO’s Job Description to determine the appropriate Korn Ferry Reference Level;
                                 2.  Undertake an indicative Job Evaluation of the CEO role based on PHB’s company size in comparison to
                                     other similar PNG Institutions, using the Korn Ferry (previously Hay) Job Evaluation methodology;
                                 3.  Conduct a market comparison by reviewing, benchmarking and analysing the CEO’s existing remuneration
                                     and benefits against comparable roles in similar Public and Private Sector organisations;
                                 4.  Review the make-up of the CEO’s package and advise on current practice in the PNG Market;
                                 5.  Develop and recommend a salary benefits structure based on an appropriate salary baseline;
                                 6.  Produce a Report detailing BHC’s Findings and Recommendations; and
                                 7.  Prepare a Remuneration Submission for the Board’s and SCMC’s consideration
                                 Based on Job Evaluation Results we will undertake a market review to confirm where the CEO’s position sits in
                                 comparison to the PNG market:
                                 1.  Prepare a summary showing where the CEO’s position sits against the comparison market with respect to
                                     Base Salary, Fixed Annual Reward and Total Annual Reward.
                                 2.  Indicate where there are internal and external equity issues of the position against the PNG Market.
                                 3.  Provide related data and recommendations for an appropriate Pay and Remuneration setting for
                                     consideration.
                                 4.  Prepare a Submission to the Board recommending a competitive remuneration package.

                                 Our Professional Fees:
                                 •   Job Evaluation & Remuneration Review for CEO Role:                          K 12,000 plus GST
                                 •   Board Report detailing Findings & Recommendations:                          K   6,000 plus GST
                                 •   Prepare an SRC / SCMC Submission, if required:                              K   8,000 plus GST

                                 We would envisage the exercise taking approximately 2 weeks from receipt of all the necessary information
                                 including PHB’s Corporate Plan, updated Organisation Structure, Position Description, Salary Grade Table,
                                 Salary Structure and REM Data for the CEO position. This timeframe assumes prompt turn around on acceptance
                                 and finalisation of the Interim & Draft Final Reports
